expect.arrive: Sunrise at 6,646 ft is windy and often near freezing in late September; the visitor center doesn't open until 9am.
expect.parking: By Sept 30 the 235-space lot is first-come, first-served, no time limit or shuttle needed.

paths.do: Watch sunrise from the Logan Pass lot and boardwalk edge, no hike.
Walk the boardwalk to the overlook and back.

paths.opt: Full loop plus St Mary stops
paths.do: Hidden Lake Overlook, then drive down to Sun Point and St. Mary Falls.

alt: Wild Goose Island Saint Mary Lake
d06s1.seasonal: GTSR's alpine section through Logan Pass can close for snow anytime from early September; NPS says it's typically open through the third Monday of October (Oct 19, 2026), but closures as early as Sept 3 have occurred — check nps.gov/glac road status the week before.

expect.arrive: Trail of the Cedars boardwalk is right off the road; the Avalanche Lake trailhead shares the same lot.
expect.parking: Avalanche Creek lot is small and is consistently the first in the park to fill.

paths.do: Flat boardwalk loop through old-growth cedar, no elevation gain.
Continue past the cedars up to the lake and back.
Skip the hike, stop at the lodge and lakeshore instead.

alt: Trail of the Cedars Glacier National Park

trail.from: Avalanche Creek / Trail of the Cedars trailhead

expect.arrive: Two-lane US-2 through forest; Kootenai Falls is a short walk down from a large roadside pullout.
expect.parking: Kootenai Falls pullout is large and rarely full outside summer weekends.

paths.do: Stay on US-2, stop only for photos from the car.
Walk down to the falls viewpoint and swinging bridge.

expect.arrive: Highway drive with the Selkirks to the west; the Pack River detour is unpaved and only worth it if the larch are turning.

paths.do: Stay on US-95, no detour.
Turn up gravel Upper Pack River Road for golden tamarack views.

expect.arrive: City Beach is a short walk from downtown parking; the Long Bridge and open lake are right behind it.
expect.parking: Downtown Sandpoint street parking and the City Beach lot fill on nice afternoons.

paths.do: Walk the beach and watch boats on the lake.
Paved path along the creek from downtown, flat and short.
Continue along the lakeshore trail toward Ponderay.

expect.arrive: Highway drive past two lakes; Farragut and Silverwood are both roadside stops, not required detours.

paths.do: US-95 to I-90, no stops.
Walk the shoreline near the old naval training station.

expect.arrive: Riverfront Park sits right downtown; the falls are visible from the pedestrian bridges within minutes of any garage.
expect.parking: Several downtown parking garages border the park; none are free, none are huge.

paths.do: Walk the pedestrian bridges over both falls channels.
Loop the paths on both riverbanks past the Pavilion and Clocktower.
Walk a few blocks over to see the historic lobby.

expect.arrive: Long highway push from I-90 to US-2; Cashmere and Ohme Gardens are the only reasons to leave the car before Tumwater Canyon.

paths.do: I-90 to US-2, no stops.
Quick walk through downtown Cashmere.
Walk the alpine garden paths overlooking the valley.

expect.arrive: Front Street is pedestrian-only and packed for Oktoberfest opening weekend; expect a slow walk-in from wherever you park.
expect.parking: Downtown lots fill early on Oktoberfest weekend; expect to park several blocks out.

paths.do: Walk the main street and browse storefronts.
Stop into Front Street Park for the Oktoberfest tent.
